newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos says court amends order in suit.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos says court amends order in suit.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Friday a federal court has allowed plaintiffs in a lawsuit, which had previouly been dismissed, to file an amended complaint against it and other defendants.
The U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada amended a previous order that dismissed a purported class action lawsuit brought by shareholders of Stratosphere Corp.
Grand Casinos said the amended order gives plaintiffs until August 22 to submit an amended complaint. The defendants would then be required to respond to the amended complaint.
The latest court action amends a May 21 order that found the plaintiff's complaint failed to specifically allege facts supporting their claims.
Allegations made in the suit included claims that Grand Casinos, Stratosphere and some of their officers and directors violated certain securities laws and regulations.
Grand Casinos owns 42 percent of the stock of Stratosphere.
